svg.title: Comparison of CV-distance distributions for three cross-validation strategies
svg.desc: Three stacked density plots. In each, a fixed grey sample-to-sample curve sits on the left and a fixed teal sample-to-prediction curve sits to the right. A bold coral CV-distances curve moves: for random k-fold CV it overlaps the grey curve on the far left (over-optimistic); for leave-country-out CV it sits to the right of the teal curve (over-pessimistic); for kNNDM CV it overlays the teal curve (realistic).
